title: BOM from governed instance data: deduplicated QTO grouped by a category rule table, every line traced to its model elements (implements ARPL-BOM-0001)
use_when: A GC or estimator needs quantities to buy against from a federation that exports a standard instance-parameter schedule with instance keys
A quantity must be traced back to the model elements that make it up
not_for: Procurement quantities (waste, purchase units, suppliers): those need the GC item table
Projects without instance keys or unique ids in the export: run ARPL-PAR-0003 first

environment.tool: ZEN ACC Gate Export Schedules + standards/bom/build_bom.py (Python 3, standard library)
environment.model: Autodesk sample Snowdon Towers, 6 cloud discipline models

changelog.change: First recorded with the BOM standard ARPL-BOM-0001 (IN-0025)
v03: curtain wall mullions by length; nested parts as named exceptions; rule codes must equal instance-key codes (IN-0026)
